title: Brazil's audit court TCU: none of 239 federal bodies assessed has fully implemented the basic cybersecurity controls
date_note: Date of the TCU high-risk list release as reported by Tele.Sintese on 18 November; the TCU document itself was not read.
summary: According to Tele.Sintese, Brazil's federal audit court TCU found in its third high-risk list that none of the 239 organisations in the Sisp system has fully implemented the 56 basic controls (IG1 group, PPSI 2.0). The indicator is unchanged from 2024, when none had reached 100%. The report also notes no national cybersecurity authority with broad powers.
plain: Brazil's audit court says none of the 239 federal bodies it assessed has put in place all 56 basic cybersecurity controls, the same as in 2024.
exec: A government audit finds no assessed federal body fully meets the basic controls, which matters for suppliers and partners of Brazilian public bodies.
impact: Audit finding on controls; no incident described.

validation.note: Only Tele.Sintese read; the TCU's own document was not read.

review.note: 239 bodies, 56 controls, IG1 PPSI 2.0, 2024 comparison, third LAR, date 18 Nov, national authority point match Tele.Sintese
